candidates.snippet: Robert Koch is consistently described across 13 model source lists as influential for: Identified bacterial causes of diseases, founding modern bacteriology and public health; Identified the bacterial causes of tuberculosis, cholera, and anthrax, establishing modern bacteriology and medical diagnostics; Founder of modern bacteriology, identifying the causes of tuberculosis, cholera, and anthrax; Identified the specific causative agents of tuberculosis, cholera, and anthrax, establishing Koch's postulates as the gold standard for infectious disease diagnosis; Identified pathogens for tuberculosis, cholera, anthrax; Identified pathogens causing tuberculosis, cholera, anthrax; Identified bacteria causing tuberculosis, cholera, and anthrax, founding medical microbiology; Bacteriology; disease causation standards.
